beats.heading: The game in brief
beats.narration_text: The Little Flame Witch is an H-D two-D cave action game: aim fireballs with the mouse, fight through a cold cave, and defeat the great wolf at the bottom.
beats.script_text: The Little Flame Witch is an HD-2D cave action game: aim fireballs with the mouse, fight through a cold cave, and defeat the great wolf at the bottom.
beats.label: mixed

qc.contrast_reason: A real captured frame and a portrait fill most of the card; the brief text below them is checked in its own region.

beats.heading: GDD 1 · Design pillars
beats.narration_text: Four pillars: your fire is the only warmth, every failure is fair, readable even muted, small witch, big threat.
beats.script_text: Four pillars: your fire is the only warmth, every failure is fair, readable even muted, small witch, big threat.
beats.label: constructed

beats.heading: GDD 2 · Core gameplay loop
beats.narration_text: The loop: move, jump, aim, fire and read each growl; the slice will chain short levels to the great wolf.
beats.script_text: The loop: move, jump, aim, fire and read each growl; the slice will chain short levels to the great wolf.
beats.label: constructed

beats.heading: GDD 3 · Player experience goals
beats.narration_text: She should feel small but capable when an early shot cancels a lunge, and relieved when the cave falls quiet.
beats.script_text: She should feel small but capable when an early shot cancels a lunge, and relieved when the cave falls quiet.
beats.label: constructed

beats.heading: GDD 4 · Core mechanics
beats.narration_text: Built today: run, jump with coyote time, aim and cast; a pit or zero HP shows the reason and restarts.
beats.script_text: Built today: run, jump with coyote time, aim and cast; a pit or zero HP shows the reason and restarts.
beats.label: real

beats.heading: GDD 5 · Systems: the wolf and health
beats.narration_text: Each wolf runs a phase table, growl, lunge, recover, and a hit during the growl cancels the lunge.
beats.script_text: Each wolf runs a phase table, growl, lunge, recover, and a hit during the growl cancels the lunge.
beats.label: real

beats.heading: GDD 6 · Progression
beats.narration_text: No levelling: she'll gain one heal spell from the first chest, and each level will add harder threats.
beats.script_text: No levelling: she'll gain one heal spell from the first chest, and each level will add harder threats.
beats.label: constructed

beats.heading: GDD 7 · World and environment
beats.narration_text: One cold cave in two to three short levels, where warmth comes only from fire.
beats.script_text: One cold cave in two to three short levels, where warmth comes only from fire.
beats.label: constructed

beats.heading: GDD 8 · Narrative
beats.narration_text: Four short, skippable scenes with portraits will tell a simple story, from the cave mouth to the great wolf.
beats.script_text: Four short, skippable scenes with portraits will tell a simple story, from the cave mouth to the great wolf.
beats.label: constructed

beats.narration_text: The witch and the cave wolves exist as sprites; the great wolf exists only as concept art.
beats.script_text: The witch and the cave wolves exist as sprites; the great wolf exists only as concept art.

beats.heading: GDD 12 · Feature list
beats.narration_text: Must, should and could; the smallest playable version is one three-D room, one wolf, and my pin passing.
beats.script_text: Must, should and could; the smallest playable version is one 3D room, one wolf, and my pin passing.

beats.heading: GDD 13 · Out of scope
beats.narration_text: Out of scope: multiplayer, saves, levelling and shops, and a web export.
beats.script_text: Out of scope: multiplayer, saves, levelling and shops, and a web export.
beats.label: constructed

beats.heading: GDD 14 · Technical requirements
beats.narration_text: Godot four point seven point two, Forward+, a Windows build, aiming for 60 frames per second at ten-eighty p, to be measured.
beats.script_text: Godot 4.7.2, Forward+, a Windows build, aiming for 60 frames per second at 1080p, to be measured.
beats.label: constructed

beats.heading: GDD 15 · Risks
beats.narration_text: The main risk: two-D into three-D could break what works, so one room comes first, judged by my Assignment 7 pin.
beats.script_text: The main risk: 2D into 3D could break what works, so one room comes first, judged by my Assignment 7 pin.
beats.label: constructed

beats.heading: GDD 16 · Open questions
beats.narration_text: Open questions: a two-D layer or three-D bodies, two levels or three, and pixel sprites under depth of field.
beats.script_text: Open questions: a 2D layer or 3D bodies, two levels or three, and pixel sprites under depth of field.
beats.label: constructed

beats.heading: Question 1 · What it is
beats.narration_text: Question one: the artifact will be a Windows E-X-E in a zip, a vertical slice from title to end screen.
beats.script_text: Question one: the artifact will be a Windows exe in a zip, a vertical slice from title to end screen.
beats.label: constructed

beats.heading: Question 2 · Why anyone would care
beats.narration_text: Why care? It will put Octopath Traveler's H-D two-D look together with Metal Slug-style shooting and a mouse-aimed fireball; Octopath is turn-based, Metal Slug fires in fixed directions, Hollow Knight is a big cave with progression, and I've played all three.
beats.script_text: Why care? It will put Octopath Traveler's HD-2D look together with Metal Slug-style shooting and a mouse-aimed fireball; Octopath is turn-based, Metal Slug fires in fixed directions, Hollow Knight is a big cave with progression, and I've played all three.
beats.label: constructed

beats.heading: Question 3 · Who opens it, and the first sixty seconds
beats.narration_text: For a gameplay programmer role, the reader, a hiring manager or lead, will unzip, double-click, and be playing within a minute.
beats.script_text: For a gameplay programmer role, the reader, a hiring manager or lead, will unzip, double-click, and be playing within a minute.

beats.heading: Question 4 · What it proves
beats.narration_text: It will prove I build and verify gameplay systems: I pinned the wolf before the growl cancel, and thirty-eight headless runs passed in a fresh clone.
